messages:
ashley: Heads-up — after rotating IdP JWK this morning, SCIM jobs started showing 429/backoff and a few users failed to provision. Log snippet:
```
 2024-06-18T09:14:22Z scim-worker[42]: provisioning failed user=alice@example.com err=signature verification failed: kid not found
 2024-06-18T09:14:23Z scim-worker[42]: retry backoff 120s
```

maria.v: Oof. Did the IdP metadata endpoint get updated with the new jwk?

ashley: Yes metadata updated at 09:12 UTC, but audit logs show some tokens still presenting kid=old-key. Also seeing KMS decrypt errors for service-account tokens used by the SCIM worker: `decryption failed: key version mismatch`.

devon: That sounds like the KMS envelope key rotated but the wrapped blobs weren't rewrapped. Our SCIM tokens are encrypted under alias/redwood/scim. @sre-oncall any KMS rotation events around 09:10?

sre-oncall: KMS audit shows an automated rotation job at 2024-06-18T09:09:58Z. It rotated the data key. We forgot to run the rewrap for long-lived wrapped blobs. I'll pause rotation for that alias and prepare a rewrap.

security-eng: Flagging as potential exposure window — some error paths logged token material on fallback. Need to scan audit logs for any raw-token leakage and start vuln triage.

idp-bot: metadata refreshed, jwks.json served: https://idp.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json (kids: new-20240618, old-20230103)

ashley: Immediate mitigation: configure SCIM workers to accept both kids (old + new) and requeue failed jobs. Longer term: rewrap service-account tokens under the new CMK version. Who can run rewrap?

devon: I can. Rewrap steps: 1) stop scim worker pool, 2) run `./tools/rewrap_tokens --prefix=scim --kms-alias=alias/redwood/scim`, 3) verify counts, 4) restart pool. Will run now.

maria.v: Also check RBAC bindings — we pushed a role-schema change last week that changed sub_claim -> user_id mapping. If provisioning uses old assertion format some users may be assigned wrong roles. Add an RBAC smoke test after rewrap.

ashley: Good point — add an eval for role mapping post-rewrap. For audit search: `aws s3api get-object --bucket redwood-audit --key auth/2024/06/18/*.log` then grep for patterns like `token:` or `Bearer ` to detect accidental logging. If we find anything, rotate impacted tokens and escalate.

sre-oncall: Rewrap finished: 7,012 tokens processed, 12 manual rewrap failures (fixed). SCIM workers restarted. Backoff rate has dropped to baseline in monitoring. Previously failed users are provisioning successfully.

security-eng: I'll run vuln triage and search for any raw-token prints. If fallback logging shipped to prod we'll open an incident (TLP:AMBER) and notify legal/cust-sec. Also recommend creating a policy: do not auto-rotate KMS keys with active wrapped tokens — require a rewrap window.

ashley: After-action TODOs: (1) update KMS rotation runbook to include a rewrap phase and a dry-run check, (2) make `rewrap_tokens` idempotent + scheduled, (3) add an automated audit that scans logs for token exposure after rotations, (4) add a canary to jwk metadata rotations that validates SCIM/OIDC clients accept new keys before deprecating old ones.

devon: PR incoming for scheduled rewrap + healthcheck: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/564 (includes a canary test against a small scim worker subset).

maria.v: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — filing a COS ticket to adjust the rotation policy and will close this thread after PR merge + COS ticket created.
